name: Farm Soil
description: Free 8K farm soil texture with dark brown, slightly damp earth, crumbly clods, fine grit and stray roots; rough, matte surface with rich micro detail.
info: One of our nearby neighbors has a small farm in their yard and they had ploughed the soil recently. Was a good opportunity to scan it. Tried to scan it carefully because walking over it would compact the soil and leave footmarks.
